ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity (black) pixels to high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central contiguous black region extending from the peduncle to the trailing edge. The left distal lobe displays a diffused white mottling pattern. The right distal lobe features a distinct high-contrast white patch containing internal dark linear striations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped central depression with a calculated aperture of approximately 95 degrees and a bounding-box depth estimated at 15% of the fluke's vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated boundary with approximately 12-15 peaks per lobe; the right distal edge shows higher pixel-amplitude variations (jagged peaks) than the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward sweep starting from the notch and terminating in pointed distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, localized dark pixel clusters (focal spots) distributed within the white pigmentation on the distal right fluke lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three to four distinct, unaligned parallel dark linear striations (rake marks) cutting through the high-intensity white patch on the outer right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake-mark scarring on the distal region of the right lobe; irregular jagged profile on the far left tip suggesting historical tissue loss.
